messages:
Olivia CS: Heads-up: renewal-risk report is inflated for the June signups. Pulled a sample and ~28% look like identity variants (email alias / missing SSO). export: s3://cs/exports/june_id_noise.csv
Noah Data: I ran a quick cluster, many rows normalize to the same canonical identity after lowering and stripping +tags. SQL used:
```sql
select lower(regexp_replace(email,'\\+.*','')) as canon_email, count(*) as cnt
from accounts
where created_at >= '2025-06-01'
group by 1
order by cnt desc limit 50;
```
Noah Data: Proposal: create `signup_identity_id` (md5 of canonical key) and change scoring to count distinct `signup_identity_id` per org. Also set `identity_sibling=true` on non-primary rows so CS doesn't duplicate outreach.
Priya Ops: Ops plan: nightly non-blocking job will compute `signup_identity_id` and write to a staging table. We'll exclude rows with `identity_sibling=true` from playbook triggers and renewal aggregates. We'll also surface a small review list of top clusters for manual review.
Victor Onboard: Playbook change request: replace `raw_trial_count` with `distinct_signup_id_count` and add a 7-day cooldown after a change in identity flags to avoid chatter. I'll open a CST ticket and draft PR. ETA: PR tomorrow. Assigning @Noah Data and @Priya Ops.
Olivia CS: Small UX ask: add a one-question micro-survey on signup when the system suspects a duplicate: "Are you joining a teammate's existing account?" yes/no + optional teammate email. Feed responses back into the dedupe pipeline.
Priya Ops: We'll include the micro-survey payload in the review ticket so CS sees the user's intent. Backfill job will run for the past 4 months.
Noah Data: I'll add a Grafana metric `cs.signup_identity_dup_rate` and an alert at 0.05. If the metric rises after backfill we'll hold the rollout for investigation.
TicketBot: CST-722 created: "signup identity normalization + playbook gating" assigned to Victor Onboard, Noah Data, Priya Ops.
AlertBot: Scheduled job `signup-identity-backfill` on 2025-07-28T03:30:00Z (job_id: sib-20250728-01) :white_check_mark:
Victor Onboard: Plan: (1) night job to compute ids, (2) backfill & test healthscore in staging, (3) deploy playbook logic under flag, (4) monitor metrics, (5) flip flag. Thanks all :sparkles:
